```instr
DEFINE INSTRUMENT multiplexing_spectrometer(lam = 4.05, A1 = 37.14, A2 = 74.28)

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
  yheight = 0.12,
  xwidth = 0.03,
  dist = 1.0,
  focus_xw = 0.03,
  focus_yh = 0.12,
  lambda0 = lam,
  dlambda = 0.4,
  flux = 1e12
) AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT guide = Guide(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.12,
  w2 = 0.03,
  h2 = 0.12,
  l = 20.0,
  m = 2.0
) AT (0, 0, 1.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT mono_arm = Arm() AT (0, 0, 21.2) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT mono = Monochromator_flat(
  zwidth = 0.15,
  yheight = 0.12,
  mosaich = 40,
  mosaicv = 40,
  DM = 3.355
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_arm ROTATED (0, A1, 0) RELATIVE mono_arm

COMPONENT out_arm = Arm() AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_arm ROTATED (0, A2, 0) RELATIVE mono_arm

COMPONENT mono_lam = L_monitor(
  nL = 200,
  filename = "mono_lam.dat",
  xwidth = 0.06,
  yheight = 0.12,
  Lmin = lam - 1,
  Lmax = lam + 1,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 0.8) RELATIVE out_arm

COMPONENT sample_psd = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 60,
  ny = 60,
  filename = "sample_psd.dat",
  xwidth = 0.05,
  yheight = 0.1,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 1.5) RELATIVE out_arm

COMPONENT ana_arm = Arm() AT (0, 0, 2.5) RELATIVE out_arm

COMPONENT ana = Monochromator_flat(
  zwidth = 0.12,
  yheight = 0.12,
  mosaich = 40,
  mosaicv = 40,
  DM = 3.355
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ana_arm ROTATED (0, -A1, 0) RELATIVE ana_arm

COMPONENT det_arm = Arm() AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ana_arm ROTATED (0, -A2, 0) RELATIVE ana_arm

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 60,
  ny = 60,
  filename = "det.dat",
  xwidth = 0.06,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 0.8) RELATIVE det_arm

END
```
